note: Interior length of the bought ABS box, lid off.
Measured with the lid ribs accounted for, not to the rim.

instrument: esp_flash_get_size() on the board over USB
note: The listing said 16 MB. Silicon says 8. Board definition and silicon agree; the listing was wrong.
Nominal 1.2k. 1200/1190 gives ~1.008 A charge, so a 2000 mAh cell charges at ~0.50 C. Schematic is not silicon - this is why it was metered.

instrument: Fluke 117, DC volts at the plug before first connection
note: Checked BEFORE plugging anything in. Connector polarity is not standardised.

instrument: Mitutoyo calipers, across the thickest point of the pouch
note: Seller said 7.0 mm. The pouch is 7.4 mm at its thickest and pouches grow slightly with age. It still clears the 22 mm interior.

instrument: Fluke 117 in series with the battery positive lead, uA range, USB DISCONNECTED
note: 12 uA. USB must be disconnected for this reading to mean anything, and the charger holds BAT at float while it is attached.

instrument: 0.1 ohm shunt, scope, mean over a 9 s wake cycle
note: Mean, not peak. The peak is ~240 mA during Wi-Fi TX and is what the bulk cap is for.

instrument: RSSI logged from the access point, box closed, sensor in its final position in the greenhouse
note: Range-tested in place rather than on the desk. 46 m against a 40 m target.
Excludes the lead exit. Close enough to the listing to be uninteresting, which is the usual outcome and still worth ten seconds.
